operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the radical resonance unit sieve as ledger 1282
operations.body: Ledger 1282 extracts the congruence corollary of 1281. With R_q=rad(exp K*exp A_q), compatible indices are exactly the units modulo R_q; the indicator is periodic, multiplicatively closed, and has density phi(R_q)/R_q. Five radical families pass 5,049 exact checks. Scope is deliberately narrow: this is a finite algebraic compatibility sieve, not an Euler product, Carrier-prime distribution, geometric Frobenius spectrum, or physical selection theorem. No build was run.
